messages:
rachel_o: Quick tidy-up thread for Predict GA acceptance — aiming to lock SLA wording, pricing examples, docs scope, canary cadence, monitoring SLIs, and support rota before we announce. Please ack or flag blockers. TL;DR: target GA next Thu, canary starts Wed. @devin_m @theo_k @laura_p

devin_m: From infra: capacity and autoscaling validated on staging. Suggest canary cohorts: internal -> 0.5% partners -> 5% -> full. Also proposing an explicit burst-to-dedicated handoff doc so customers understand transient throttles. Added checklist here: https://staging.ops.redwood/runbooks/predict-burst-handoff

theo_k: Pricing/finops: we agreed token-metering with 1k-token billing bucket. Need sample invoice lines and an FAQ blurb about trial credits. Also confirm overage behavior: return 429 with X-Quota-Remaining/X-Quota-Reset headers and link to upgrade flow. I'll draft the billing examples.

laura_p: Docs: Quickstart, errors & retries, quota blurb, and migration note for Dedicated are the GA must-haves. Streaming audio example can be "preview" and shipped post-GA. I'll own the quickstart + error semantics. Can someone pair on the migration blurb?

rachel_o: @theo_k please own the migration blurb with a short contact pointer to sales ops. We can mark streaming preview clearly in the docs and add a prominent note in changelog.

legal-bot: Legal check: trial-credit language requires explicit refund policy. Suggested safe copy: "Trial credits are promotional; no cash refunds. For billing disputes contact billing@redwood.ai within 30 days." Product + legal sign-off required.

devin_m: Monitoring: propose SLIs p95/p99 latency, error-rate (4xx+5xx), and model-quality SLI over sample prompt set per-customer. Alerts: p99 > 400ms OR error-rate > 0.75% sustained over 10m -> page oncall. Dashboard: https://dash.redwood/predict-ga. Need synthetic smoke every 5m.

theo_k: For rollback triggers: automated routing to quantized-fallback variant + post to #incidents + create incident ticket. Manual approval needed to revert. Infra will implement the switch; ops-bot will post the summary.

laura_p: Support: I'll be primary for first 48h post-GA, but need one evening backup (UTC-8). Volunteers? Also need a one-page runbook: steps to detect, fallback, and customer comms. Will draft and link to runbook.

rachel_o: I'll take evenings for week1. Please ensure runbook includes canned customer email templates and steps to file a support ticket to sales for quota increases.

devin_m: CI smoke snippet for docs/CI and canary: ```bash
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/predict -d '{"input":"smoke test"}' | jq '. | {status: .status, tokens: .tokens[0:3]}'
``` assert HTTP 200 + status == "ok". We'll run every 5m against canary.

legal-bot: Flag: include the exact trial credit terms in the billing FAQ or we risk legal hold. Need product + finance sign-off before GA.

rachel_o: Summary of owners: rachel_o (launch lead & comms), devin_m (infra/runbooks/monitoring), theo_k (pricing/finops/billing examples), laura_p (docs/support/runbook). Open blocker: legal sign-off on trial/refund language. If legal clears by EOD we consider rollcall green and schedule canary per ops-bot.

laura_p: I'll push the docs PR now (quickstart + errors + quota blurb). Streaming preview note added.

theo_k: I'll land billing examples and FAQ draft by EOD and ping legal.

devin_m: Autoscaler tuning finalized; will enable synthetic smoke and canary CI jobs tonight.

legal-bot: Awaiting product confirmation of billing FAQ location; will review once linked.

rachel_o: Thanks everyone. If no objections I'll send ship announcement and schedule canary after legal ack. Leaving thread open for the final legal ping. :eyes:
